required scenes (story order):
S1: in ancient times, people did not know which plants can be eaten, so people often got sick after eating some plants
S2: 神农decided to find out which plants are safe to eat and which are not, so he climbed mountains to try different plants
S3: 神农found茶and took a record
S4: 神农tried 夹竹桃 and fainted
S5: a person in blue stopped by and gave灵芝to 神农，神农felt better after eating灵芝
S6: another person in brown came by and had a conversation with 神农
S7: 神农takes record of灵芝and夹竹桃

learner's story:
古代的时候，一个老先生叫神农，住在中国。他的生活高兴是高兴，但是他的人民不知道什么植物能吃。他们一吃植物就生病了。神农想帮他们，所以他去找对身体有好处的植物。他翻过山以后，找到两个又黄又漂亮的花。第一个花，神农做茶，好喝得很。第二个花，一吃就身体坏了。别的人正好在走路呢。他们走过的时候，神农问他们：“麻烦你们能给我拿个蘑菇？”神农告诉他们，几棵植物可以是药，特别是灵芝。然后神农回家告诉他的人民什么植物能吃。他说：“很多植物可以是毒。比方说夹竹桃。”神农帮很多人，所以今天中国人还记得他。

scenes.core: People did not know which plants were edible and became sick after eating plants.
evidence: 古代的时候，一个老先生叫神农，住在中国。
但是他的人民不知道什么植物能吃。
他们一吃植物就生病了。
details_left_out: that this happened often after eating only some plants

scenes.core: 神农 decides to find safe and unsafe plants and climbs mountains to try plants.
evidence: 神农想帮他们，所以他去找对身体有好处的植物。
他翻过山以后，找到两个又黄又漂亮的花。
第二个花，一吃就身体坏了。
details_left_out: that he tried many different plants to discover which ones were unsafe

scenes.core: 神农 finds 茶 and makes a record.
evidence: 第一个花，神农做茶，好喝得很。
scenes.missing_part: 神农 took a record of 茶.

scenes.core: 神农 tries 夹竹桃 and faints.
evidence: 第二个花，一吃就身体坏了。
scenes.missing_part: The flower he ate was 夹竹桃, and he fainted.

scenes.core: A passerby gives 神农 灵芝, and he feels better after eating it.
scenes.missing_part: A person gave 神农 灵芝, and 神农 ate it and felt better.

scenes.core: Another passerby has a conversation with 神农.
evidence: 他们走过的时候，神农问他们：“麻烦你们能给我拿个蘑菇？”
details_left_out: that this was one other person

scenes.core: 神农 records 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.
scenes.missing_part: 神农 took a record of both 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.

feedback: After finding 茶, add that 神农 wrote it down.
After the tea plant, say that 神农 ate 夹竹桃 and fainted.
Between 神农 fainting and the next conversation, add that a person gave him 灵芝, and he ate it and felt better.
Before 神农 goes home to tell the people, add that he wrote down 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.
